pages.title: Laser Head
pages.text: A laser rod between two mirrors, pumped by a flash of light, behind a Faraday isolator so no reflection can come back into it. A single frequency, steady for hours.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Geometric Optics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Laser Interferometer, Step Laser.
